_liesmich: Alle Bibliotheksclips mit ihrem Prompt. 'neu' = noch nicht erzeugt. 'ersetzen' = vorhanden, faellt aber aus der Rezeptur (siehe rezept.md) und sollte neu erzeugt werden. Die Prompts der Clips 01-15 sind REKONSTRUIERT: die Originale wurden nicht aufbewahrt, diese Fassungen beschreiben das vorhandene Bild und folgen der Rezeptur. Ab 18 sind es die echten Prompts.

clips.name: stadt
clips.grund: Eine naechtliche Skyline hat mit Longevity nichts zu tun und traegt die Marke nicht.
clips.prompt: Wide static shot of a dark city skyline at night with cold blue light on the glass facades, traffic reduced to slow streaks of light far below, deep black sky. Slow almost imperceptible push-in. Cinematic, cold, unhurried.

clips.name: zelle
clips.prompt: Extreme macro of a single luminous green spherical cell with fine hair-like cilia drifting in near-black fluid, smaller cells blurred behind it. The cilia move slowly and the cell drifts a few millimetres across frame. Microscopic, bioluminescent green on black, shallow depth of field.

clips.name: labor
clips.prompt: Extreme macro of a glass pipette tip releasing one clear droplet toward a row of empty glass vials below, cold overhead light, near-black background. The droplet forms, hangs, and falls in very slow motion. Clinical, cold blue, shallow depth of field, an untouched laboratory bench.

clips.name: training
clips.prompt: Wide low shot from behind a lone runner in a reflective vest on an empty road at dawn, silhouetted against a cold blue sky. Slow tracking shot following at a steady distance. Backlit, high contrast, the figure stays a silhouette throughout. Cinematic, cold, solitary.

clips.name: kaelte
clips.grund: Eine weisse Wolke auf hellem Grund — zu hell, zu wenig lesbar, faellt aus der Farbwelt.
clips.prompt: Macro of dense cold vapour rolling slowly across a dark reflective surface, lit from one side by a single cold blue light, deep black surroundings. The vapour creeps forward for the whole shot. Abstract, cold, high contrast.

clips.name: kapseln
clips.prompt: Overhead macro of a small pile of blue and metallic capsules on a matte black surface, one single hard light from the left throwing long shadows. Very slow lateral dolly across the pile. Product photography feel, cold, shallow depth of field, an untouched surface.

clips.name: schlaf
clips.prompt: Wide macro of rumpled dark bed linen in a night-dark room, a single cold blue light source low on the horizon of the frame. Almost imperceptible slow pan across the folds. Quiet, empty, cold blue, cinematic.

clips.name: gehirn
clips.prompt: Abstract macro of a single glowing neuron with countless fine branching dendrites radiating into black space, teal and pale green light travelling outward along the branches. Slow rotation around the cell body. Microscopic, luminous, deep black background.

clips.name: darm
clips.prompt: Extreme macro travelling slowly along soft folded tissue lit from within by warm amber light, the folds curving away into darkness. Continuous forward dolly through the passage. Organic, warm, endoscopic feel, shallow depth of field.

clips.name: blut
clips.grund: Grelles Pink statt Tiefrot — bricht die Farbwelt am staerksten.
clips.prompt: Extreme macro inside a vessel with dark red blood cells drifting past the camera, deep crimson and near-black, one cold rim light catching the cell edges. Continuous slow forward travel. Microscopic, dark, high contrast.

clips.name: fasten
clips.prompt: Overhead shot of a single empty white plate on a dark wooden table with one piece of cutlery casting a long shadow, one hard cold light from the side, everything else in shadow. Very slow rotation of the plate. Minimal, still, high contrast.

clips.name: sauna
clips.prompt: Macro of glowing hot stones with cracks of orange light between them, steam rising slowly, dark wooden slats blurred behind. Slow push-in toward the brightest stone. Warm amber on black, high contrast, cinematic.

clips.name: eisbad
clips.prompt: Macro of ice cubes on a dark wet surface with cold blue light behind them, water droplets sliding down the faces. Slow lateral dolly past the cubes. Cold, backlit, shallow depth of field, deep black background.

clips.name: kraft
clips.prompt: Extreme macro of stacked cast-iron weight plates in a dark gym, one narrow shaft of cold light grazing the knurled edges, everything else black. Very slow vertical crane up along the stack. Heavy, cold, high contrast.

clips.name: molekuel
clips.prompt: Abstract green molecular model of connected glowing spheres and rods suspended in black space, softly pulsing. Slow rotation on a vertical axis. Scientific, luminous green on black, shallow depth of field.

clips.name: peptid-tropfen
clips.prompt: Extreme macro of a single clear droplet forming on a polished steel surface, cold rim light, near-black background, very slow motion, abstract, no hands, no text

clips.name: mitochondrien
clips.prompt: Abstract cluster of glowing elongated capsule shapes pulsing softly in dark fluid, warm amber cores with teal edges, slow drift, microscopic, no text

clips.name: herzschlag
clips.prompt: Abstract waveform of soft light rising and falling across a dark surface, slow rhythmic pulse like a heartbeat, teal and deep blue, minimal, no text

clips.name: mikrobiom

clips.name: kristall
clips.grund: Ueberwiegend hell und grau — der Clip traegt keine Schrift und passt nicht zur Reihe.
clips.prompt: Slow rotation of an abstract crystalline structure suspended in black space, lit by one cold blue light from behind so the facets glow at the edges while the body stays dark. Continuous rotation for the whole shot. Scientific, minimal, deep black background.

clips.name: pulver

clips.name: blatt

clips.name: rotlicht
clips.prompt: Deep red light panel glowing in a dark room, soft haze in the air, extremely slow dolly across the surface, abstract, no people, no text

clips.name: hoehe
clips.prompt: Cold mountain air with mist moving slowly across dark rock, pale blue light before sunrise, no people, no text, cinematic

clips.name: proben
clips.grund: Warmes Gelb und flaechig ausgeleuchtet — faellt aus Farbwelt und Lichtfuehrung.
clips.prompt: Rows of sealed sample vials on a dark reflective surface, one cold overhead light picking out the caps while the background falls to black, very slow lateral dolly, shallow depth of field, an empty laboratory.

clips.name: kaffee
clips.prompt: Extreme macro of dark espresso extracting in a thin thread into a black cup, backlit by one warm amber light so the crema glows at the edge, deep black surroundings. The thread runs and the crema builds for the whole shot. Rich amber on black, shallow depth of field, an untouched counter.

clips.name: tee
clips.prompt: Extreme macro of curled green tea leaves unfurling in hot water inside a dark glass, fine strands of green colour bleeding into the water, one cold light from behind. The leaves open slowly and the colour spreads throughout. Luminous green on near-black, shallow depth of field.

clips.name: dna
clips.prompt: Abstract double helix of glowing teal strands with faint rungs between them, suspended in black space, fine particles drifting past. Slow continuous rotation on a vertical axis. Scientific, luminous, deep black background, shallow depth of field.

clips.name: telomer
clips.prompt: Extreme macro of a pale strand in black space whose tip carries a bright cold blue glowing cap, the cap dimming very slowly over the shot. Slow drift along the strand toward the tip. Microscopic, cold, minimal, deep black background.

clips.name: sanduhr
clips.prompt: Macro of fine sand falling in a thin stream through the waist of an hourglass, one hard warm amber light from the side catching the grains, the glass itself almost invisible against black. Slow push-in on the falling stream. High contrast, amber on black, an empty room.

clips.name: sonnenaufgang
clips.prompt: Wide shot of a dark horizon line with the first warm amber light breaking along it, cold blue sky above still holding night, thin cloud moving slowly. Very slow push-in toward the light. Cinematic, high contrast, an empty landscape.

clips.name: blaulicht
clips.prompt: Macro of cold blue screen light spilling into a dark room, soft haze in the air catching the beam, the source itself out of focus. Very slow lateral dolly across the beam. Cold, hazy, deep black surroundings, an empty room at night.

clips.name: atem
clips.prompt: Macro of a slow cloud of warm breath condensing in freezing air, lit from behind by one cold blue light so the vapour glows against black. The cloud expands and dissipates across the whole shot. Backlit, high contrast, abstract, deep black background.

clips.name: hrv
clips.prompt: Abstract row of thin vertical green light bars on a black surface, their heights varying irregularly then settling into an even rhythm. Slow lateral dolly along the row. Minimal, luminous green on black, shallow depth of field.

clips.name: sensor
clips.prompt: Extreme macro of a small smooth white sensor disc resting on a dark matte surface, a single cold blue indicator glowing at its centre, one hard rim light along the edge. Slow arc around the disc. Clinical, cold, deep black background, an untouched surface.

clips.name: wearable
clips.prompt: Macro of a dark smartwatch face lying on black slate, a faint teal ring of light glowing on the display, one hard light grazing the case edge. Very slow rotation of the watch. Cold, product photography feel, deep black background, an untouched surface.

clips.name: wasser
clips.prompt: Macro of clear water pouring into a dark glass, backlit by one cold light so the stream and the bubbles glow while everything else stays black. The glass fills across the whole shot. Backlit, high contrast, shallow depth of field, an untouched surface.
clips.grund: Eine ausgebrannte weisse Scheibe beherrscht das Bild — genau der Fehler, den die Rezeptur vermeiden soll.

clips.name: salz
clips.prompt: Extreme macro of coarse salt crystals on a dark stone surface, one hard warm amber light from the side making the facets glint, the background falling to black. Very slow lateral dolly across the crystals. High contrast, shallow depth of field, an untouched surface.

clips.name: aminosaeure
clips.prompt: Abstract chain of small glowing green spheres linked in a folding strand, drifting in black space, the chain slowly folding in on itself. Slow rotation while it folds. Scientific, luminous green on black, shallow depth of field.

clips.name: kollagen
clips.prompt: Extreme macro of fine amber fibrous strands weaving over one another in a dense mesh, lit by one warm light from the side, the depths of the mesh falling to black. Slow drift across the mesh. Organic, warm, shallow depth of field.

clips.name: oel
clips.prompt: Extreme macro of a single golden oil droplet falling into dark liquid and spreading in slow curling ribbons, one warm light from behind making the droplet glow. The ribbons keep unfolding to the last frame. Amber on near-black, abstract, shallow depth of field.

clips.name: pilz
clips.prompt: Timelapse macro of a pale mushroom pushing up through dark soil and opening its cap, one cool green-tinted light from above, the soil around it in deep shadow. Continuous growth across the whole shot. Organic, moody, deep black background.

clips.name: wurzel
clips.prompt: Macro of a gnarled dried root lying on dark stone, one hard warm amber light from the side raking across its texture, the background black. Very slow lateral dolly along the root. Earthy, high contrast, shallow depth of field, an untouched surface.

clips.name: beeren
clips.prompt: Extreme macro of dark red berries beaded with condensation on a black surface, one hard light from behind making the skins glow deep crimson. Very slow rotation around the cluster. Rich dark red on black, shallow depth of field, an untouched surface.

clips.name: fermentation
clips.prompt: Extreme macro of small bubbles rising slowly through dark amber liquid inside a glass vessel, lit from one side so the bubbles catch the light against a black background. Continuous rising for the whole shot. Warm, abstract, shallow depth of field.

clips.name: knorpel
clips.prompt: Extreme macro of a translucent layered surface with a wet sheen, cold blue light passing through it from below so the layers glow, the edges falling to black. Very slow drift across the surface. Clinical, cold, abstract, shallow depth of field.
clips.grund: Liest sich als flaches blaues Wasser, nicht als Knorpel. Als abstraktes Blau brauchbar, als Motiv nicht.

clips.name: knochen
clips.prompt: Extreme macro travelling slowly through the porous lattice of bone, cold blue light picking out the struts while the cavities stay black. Continuous forward dolly through the lattice. Scientific, cold, high contrast, shallow depth of field.

clips.name: muskelfaser
clips.prompt: Extreme macro of parallel deep red muscle fibres with fine striations, one hard light raking along them, the gaps between the bundles falling to black. Very slow lateral dolly along the fibres. Organic, dark crimson, shallow depth of field.

clips.name: immunzelle
clips.prompt: Macro of several luminous green cells converging slowly on one dark particle in near-black fluid, fine protrusions reaching toward it. The cells close in across the whole shot. Microscopic, bioluminescent green on black, shallow depth of field.

clips.name: radikale
clips.prompt: Abstract shot of small orange sparks scattering chaotically in black space, then slowly being drawn together and cooling to a calm teal glow. Continuous motion from chaos to calm across the whole shot. Luminous, high contrast, deep black background.
clips.grund: Ein blasser gelblicher Klumpen; die Bewegung von Funken zu Ruhe ist nicht zu erkennen.
